title: Effect settings with no stock equal are left out or approximated, and reported with their line
description:
As a producer, I want to be told which settings had no equal in the DAW, so that I know where the set will sound different from the render.

```gherkin
Feature: Settings with no stock equal are reported
  Scenario: A setting left out
    Given the track "a" on line 7 has "lofi bits 8 wow 30%"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the export succeeds
    And the track "a" has the device "Redux" set to 8 bits
    And the export warns: line 7, "lofi wow" has no stock equal and was left out

  Scenario: A setting approximated
    Given the track "a" on line 7 has "reverb room 0.8s"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the export succeeds
    And the export notes that the reverb type "room" was approximated

  Scenario: Nothing left out, nothing reported
    Given the score "examples/chop-shop-mixed.apr" with only effects the DAW can hold
    When I export it as a DAW set
    Then the export has no warnings about effects
```

Note: which settings are "left out" vs "approximated" is the list in `design/daw-set.md`; the scenarios use whatever M0 found (`lofi wow` and reverb types are the likely ones).
